provenance.authorship_disclosure: All 60 draft cases were mechanically authored by the assistant. Executable business references use real SQLite, multi-step values use deterministic Python, and risk cases use fixed project contracts. No case has user review or a user-authored independent business reference.
provenance.reference_isolation_policy: Candidate systems receive questions only; frozen reference SQL, results, and scoring rules are loaded by the evaluator after the candidate run and are never generated or modified by it.
